name: Asesino
description:
'''Asesino''' (Spanish for "assassin" or "murderer") is an American [[deathgrind]] [[supergroup (music)|supergroup]] and a side project of [[Fear Factory]] guitarist [[Dino Cazares]]. The band has featured members of [[Brujeria (band)|Brujeria]], [[Fear Factory]], [[Sepultura]], [[Sadistic Intent]], [[Possessed (band)|Possessed]], [[Ministry (band)|Ministry]], and [[Static-X]].

Asesino sometimes play [[Slayer]] covers live, notably "[[Angel of Death (Slayer song)|Angel of Death]]" and "[[Raining Blood]]". As with [[Brujeria (band)|Brujeria]], the lyrics are sung in Spanish and with the same subject matter of death, violence and perversion. Guitarist Asesino describes the band as "the new Brujeria." Asesino has a tendency to make satirical comments during the show, and changing the lyrics of [[Brujeria (band)|Brujeria]] songs to something more fitting.

Asesino made a guest appearance as Mexican doctors in [[Metalocalypse (season 4)|episode 57]] of ''[[Metalocalypse]]'' on [[Adult Swim]]. Campos voiced Dr. Sepultura and Cazares and Márquez voiced his assistants.
